intro.text: A race of sapient spren that live mostly in the Cognitive Realm. They are sometimes called liespren.
A race of sapient spren, the embodiment of the mathematical truths beneath the world, mostly living in the Cognitive Realm. Their Nahel bond grants the powers of the Order of Lightweavers.

description.text: In the Physical Realm a Cryptic shows as a complex, ever-shifting fractal pattern raised slightly off a surface, or now and then as a floating knot of twisting lines. Its voice buzzes, it vibrates when it speaks, and it often hums.
A Cryptic bond grows as the bonded person speaks deep truths about themselves; the more powerful the truth, the deeper the bond. Cryptics can sense when someone is lying.

Few Cryptics live out in Shadesmar; most live in Number City. They have no wish to conquer territory, so other spren don't war with them, though many find their fondness for lies and mathematics unsettling.
They are gifted translators who can learn any language, human or spren, with enough exposure, and skilled codebreakers. They can mimic voices and sounds perfectly through vibration.
Cryptics love lies and irony, gathering and humming wherever a falsehood is spoken, though they dislike the name liespren. They are themselves exceedingly honest and poor liars.

items.text: Because of the Recreance, many Cryptics believe a bond is a death sentence, yet think what they could learn from humans is worth it. Rather than leave a bonded Cryptic alone, others follow the would-be Lightweaver from Shadesmar to watch the bond grow.
Cryptics were among the first spren to begin bonding humans again.

A group of Cryptics followed Shallan for some time before her bond. They also watched King Elhokar, feeding his paranoia, and sent one of their number to bond him; he died before finishing the First Ideal, and that Cryptic bonded Hoid instead.
